text: Once upon a time there were four little Rabbits, and their names were-- Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter. They lived with their Mother in a sand-bank, underneath the root of a very big fir-tree. 'Now my dears,' said old Mrs. Rabbit one morning, 'you may go into the fields or down the lane, but don't go into Mr. McGregor's garden: your Father had an accident there; he was put in a pie by Mrs. McGregor.
title: Once upon a time there were four little Rabbits
director_note: Staged the burrow as a warm, crowded family morning so Mrs. Rabbit's warning lands as a sudden shift from cozy to caution. Kept all four children visible and reactive to her words, letting the final line about their father darken the room.
